<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Inventory Management System</title><style>body{font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;max-width:960px;margin:30px auto;padding:0 16px;line-height:1.6}pre{background:#f4f4f4;padding:12px;border-radius:6px;overflow:auto}table{border-collapse:collapse}td,th{border:1px solid #ccc;padding:6px 10px}img{max-width:100%;border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:6px}</style></head><body><h1>Inventory Management System</h1>
<p>A RESTful backend application developed using Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, and Mongoose to manage product inventory efficiently.</p>
<h2>Project Overview</h2>
<p>The Inventory Management System is designed to simplify inventory operations by providing APIs for managing products, tracking stock levels, updating product details, and generating inventory reports.</p>
<p>The application supports product CRUD operations, filtering, sorting, pagination, stock adjustments, low-stock alerts, and category-wise inventory summaries.</p>
<h2>Technologies Used</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Node.js</strong> – JavaScript runtime environment</li>
<li><strong>Express.js</strong> – Backend web framework</li>
<li><strong>MongoDB</strong> – NoSQL database</li>
<li><strong>Mongoose</strong> – MongoDB object modeling</li>
<li><strong>dotenv</strong> – Environment variable management</li>
<li><strong>Postman</strong> – API testing</li>
</ul>
<h2>Features</h2>
<h3>1. Product Management</h3>
<ul>
<li>Create new products.</li>
<li>Retrieve all products.</li>
<li>Retrieve individual products by ID.</li>
<li>Update product information.</li>
<li>Delete products.</li>
</ul>
<h3>2. Inventory Management</h3>
<ul>
<li>Adjust product stock quantities.</li>
<li>Prevent stock quantities from becoming negative.</li>
<li>Configure minimum stock levels.</li>
<li>Identify products requiring restocking.</li>
</ul>
<h3>3. Product Querying</h3>
<ul>
<li>Filter products by category.</li>
<li>Search products by name.</li>
<li>Sort products.</li>
<li>Retrieve products using pagination.</li>
</ul>
<h3>4. Inventory Reports</h3>
<ul>
<li>Generate low-stock reports.</li>
<li>Generate category-wise inventory summaries.</li>
<li>Calculate total products and quantities.</li>
<li>Calculate total inventory value.</li>
</ul>
<h3>5. Validation and Error Handling</h3>
<ul>
<li>Product field validation.</li>
<li>Duplicate SKU detection.</li>
<li>Invalid MongoDB ID handling.</li>
<li>Centralized error-handling middleware.</li>
</ul>

<pre><code class="language-text">Inventory-Management-System/

</code></pre>
<h2>Installation and Setup</h2>
<h3>Prerequisites</h3>
<p>Make sure you have installed:</p>
<ul>
<li>Node.js</li>
<li>MongoDB Community Server</li>
<li>MongoDB Compass</li>
<li>Postman</li>
</ul>
<h3>Step 1: Clone the Repository</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">git clone https://github.com/siya809026-dot/Inventory-Management-System.git
</code></pre>
<h3>Step 2: Navigate to the Project</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">cd Inventory-Management-System
</code></pre>
<h3>Step 3: Install Dependencies</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">npm install
</code></pre>
<h3>Step 4: Configure Environment Variables</h3>
<p>Create a <code>.env</code> file in the project root directory.</p>
<pre><code class="language-env">PORT=5000
MONGO_URI=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/InventoryDB
</code></pre>
<p>Make sure your local MongoDB server is running.</p>
<h3>Step 5: Start the Server</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">npm run dev
</code></pre>
<p>The server will run at:</p>
<pre><code class="language-text">http://localhost:5000
</code></pre>
<h2>API Documentation</h2>
<p>Base URL:</p>
<pre><code class="language-text">http://localhost:5000/api/products
</code></pre>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Method</th>
<th>Endpoint</th>
<th>Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>POST</td>
<td><code>/</code></td>
<td>Create a product</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>GET</td>
<td><code>/</code></td>
<td>Get all products</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>GET</td>
<td><code>/:id</code></td>
<td>Get product by ID</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>PUT</td>
<td><code>/:id</code></td>
<td>Update product</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>PATCH</td>
<td><code>/:id/stock</code></td>
<td>Adjust product stock</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>DELETE</td>
<td><code>/:id</code></td>
<td>Delete product</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>GET</td>
<td><code>/low-stock</code></td>
<td>Get low-stock products</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>GET</td>
<td><code>/category-summary</code></td>
<td>Get category-wise inventory summary</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3>Sample Product JSON</h3>
<p>Use the following JSON when creating a product:</p>
<pre><code class="language-json">{
    &quot;name&quot;: &quot;Laptop&quot;,
    &quot;sku&quot;: &quot;LAP001&quot;,
    &quot;category&quot;: &quot;Electronics&quot;,
    &quot;price&quot;: 55000,
    &quot;quantity&quot;: 20,
    &quot;minStock&quot;: 5,
    &quot;description&quot;: &quot;HP Laptop&quot;,
    &quot;supplier&quot;: &quot;HP India&quot;
}
</code></pre>

<h2>Database Information</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Database:</strong> InventoryDB</li>
<li><strong>Collection:</strong> products</li>
</ul>
<p>The application uses MongoDB locally, with Mongoose handling database operations and schema validation.</p>
